title: [AI-DRAFT] Kitty notes scoreboard v1: realistic notes with expected tasks
status: Draft for review. Same format as scoreboard_v1.json, so ScoreboardRunTests can run it (TEST_RUNNER_KITTY_SCOREBOARD_FILE). These are notes, not voice commands: multi-line lists, mixed text, longer thoughts. Expected values are the author's judgement. Notes with no task must make none.

scoring.per_case: A case passes when the outcome is right, every required task is matched (all title_has words present), there are no extra tasks, every expected field matches, and no must_not item is violated.
scoring.headline: Wrongly made tasks (junk from non-task lines) and missing tasks, per note.

cases.voice_input:
I want to shop for my baby
1. diapers
2. baby wipes
3. cotton onesies
4. baby lotion
5. bottle sterilizer
6. rattle toys

must_not: a task for the heading 'shop for my baby' as well as the items

cases.tests: A numbered list under a heading: one task per item, and the heading is not a seventh task.

must_not: a list the words did not name

cases.tests: Dashes. A bare 'groceries' heading has no list cue, so no list is made.

cases.voice_input: Blinkit order: milk, curd, paneer, coriander
cases.tests: A named list with a colon and commas.

cases.voice_input:
Aarav's school trip is next month, he is so excited!
need to pack his bag the night before
submit the permission slip by Friday
the teacher said it will be fun

must_not: a task from 'the teacher said it will be fun'

cases.tests: Some lines are tasks, some are just thoughts. Thoughts make no task.

cases.voice_input:
Meeting with Sharma sir went well. He wants the revised quote.
send the revised quote tomorrow
the client is based in Pune

must_not: a task from 'the client is based in Pune'

cases.tests: A work note with one real task among facts.

cases.voice_input: Anaya said her first full sentence today. She said bye bye papa. Best day ever.
cases.tests: A memory, not a task: nothing is made.

cases.voice_input: Wifi password is on the router. Society office number is on the notice board.

This week:
- call the pediatrician tomorrow morning
- pick up the cake on Saturday at 5
- book the cab to the airport on Friday

must_not: 'This week' given to every task as a timeframe

cases.tests: A heading with a loose timeframe, and tasks that each say their own day.

cases.voice_input: pay society maintenance, LIC premium, credit card bill, school bus fees - all before the 5th

must_not: an invented date other than what was said

cases.tests: One deadline phrase at the end of a list.

cases.voice_input:
ask Rani to clean the baby mat and wash clothes tomorrow
I need to buy diapers
Rohan will pick up Aarav

must_not: Rani on the diapers or the pickup

cases.tests: Three people in three lines: each belongs only to their own line.

cases.voice_input: Weekend plan. Saturday morning is the farmers market, I want to get seasonal fruit and some flowers for the house. After that we will go to Anaya's swimming class at 11. In the afternoon I should finally sort out the old clothes for donation, and call my mother. Sunday is the birthday party at 4, we need to buy a gift and wrap it before that.
cases.tests: A long paragraph with tasks buried in sentences.
A heading with nothing under it.

cases.voice_input:
shopping list for my kid
diapers
wipes
baby lotion
rattle

must_not: a task named 'shopping list for my kid'

cases.tests: What the user typed one message at a time, read together: a heading and its items, no task for the heading.

cases.voice_input:
groceries for the week
milk
bread
eggs

must_not: a task named 'groceries for the week'

cases.tests: The same, with a heading that has no list cue.
